def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            ph, pw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            pattern = [[grid[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            for y,x in cells:
                out[y][x] = pattern[(y-r0)%ph][(x-c0)%pw]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            colored = [(y, x) for y, x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0, 8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            r0 = min(y for y, x in colored)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in colored)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in colored)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in colored)
            ph, pw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
            pattern = [[grid[r0 + i][c0 + j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = pattern[(y - top) % ph][(x - left) % pw]
    return out
